dish.title: Castilian Garlic Soup with Poached Eggs and Spinach
dish.description: Sopa de ajo: golden sliced garlic and chunks of crusty bread toasted in olive oil, bloomed with smoked pimentón, simmered in vegetable stock with spinach, and finished by poaching eggs right in the soup. A sherry-vinegar splash brightens it.

recipe_version.title: Castilian Garlic Soup with Poached Eggs and Spinach
recipe_version.description: Sopa de ajo: golden sliced garlic and chunks of crusty bread toasted in olive oil, bloomed with smoked pimentón, simmered in vegetable stock with spinach, and finished by poaching eggs right in the soup. A sherry-vinegar splash brightens it.

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.display_name: day-old crusty bread with no milk or butter

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Thinly slice the garlic, tear the bread, and chop the parsley. Crack each egg into its own small cup.

steps.title: Toast the garlic and bread
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a wide 5-quart pot over medium-low. Cook the garlic, stirring, until pale gold, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the bread and toast, turning, until golden and crisp at the edges, 3 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Take the pot off the heat, stir in the pimentón for 10 seconds, then pour in the stock and add the salt. Return to medium heat, bring to a simmer, and cook 6 minutes so the bread softens. Stir in the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Poach the eggs
steps.body: Lower the heat so the soup barely bubbles. Slip the eggs in one at a time, spaced apart, cover, and poach 4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Stir the sherry vinegar into the broth around the eggs. Ladle into bowls with one egg each and scatter parsley.
